verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management platform, not a coding agent or development environment, so having an agent auto-detect and install toolchains and dependencies is outside its product category. Its workflow agents, developer MCP for scaffolding, and managed sandboxes do not show a coding agent that installs toolchains, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
